facts.raw_span: 20-year history of progressive skin laxity
asymptomatic yellowish coalesced papules confined to flexural areas
severe skin sagging occurred on her abdomen with loss of elasticity
no extracutaneous involvement
born to healthy nonconsanguineous parents
younger sister had developed the same skin symptoms
Thick and leathery skinfolds on the neck, axillae, inguinal regions, abdomen, and limbs, with yellowish papules scattered on the dorsal neck
Low clotting activity of factor X (52.2%; reference range, 77%-131%)
Prolonged prothrombin time (12.8 seconds; reference range, 10.4-12.6 seconds)
excessive calcification of elastic fiber fragments scattered in the reticular dermis (von Kossa staining)
compound heterozygous sequence variation in GGCX gene
c.1167_1172delCTGGACinsGGGAA (p. Asn389Lys fs*13) in exon 8
